d: Junaid Perfumes is the oldest perfume house in the GCC, established in 1910 in the Kingdom of Bahrain and renowned for its Arabian fine fragrances. Built over four generations, the company combines traditional craftsmanship with modern manufacturing to create timeless products. Junaid Perfumes works with top global suppliers of raw materials and maintains strong ethical values rooted in its founders’ principles. The brand aims to be recognized worldwide as a leading pillar of Arabian perfumery, bottling distinctive, emotionally resonant fragrances for customers across the globe. The company continues to expand its international presence while keeping its heritage at the center of its operations.

The Head of Sales will lead the overall sales strategy and performance for Junaid Perfumes, driving revenue growth and market expansion across GCC. This full-time, on-site role is responsible for setting sales targets, developing sales plans, and overseeing execution across retail network. The Head of Sales will manage and coach the sales team, monitor key performance indicators, and optimize processes to improve conversion rates and customer retention. Day-to-day tasks include conducting market and competitor analysis, maintaining strategic relationships with key accounts and partners, collaborating with marketing and operations teams, and preparing regular performance reports for senior leadership. The Head of Sales will also contribute to pricing strategies, new product launches, and initiatives that strengthen Junaid Perfumes’ brand presence locally and internationally.
